parsed.post: New personal best! Hit 0.991642 by increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 on the D6/AR64/LR0.04 baseline. It looks like stronger regularization is beneficial here. Next: testing if even higher WEIGHT_DECAY or adjusting WARMUP_RATIO can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.05 to 0.1 to see if further regularization improves generalization/stability.
